name: inziva
source:
A visual novel about you. Yes, you. "inziva" examines talking with your alter egos about your depression and traumas.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2355710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一本关于你的视觉小说。是的，你。“inziva”检查与你的另一个自我谈论你的抑郁和创伤。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2355710/]Steam[/url]]
